claim: A real-Python mapping requirement whose value is a binary expression lies outside the constructive image of the inherited single-field repair-operation language at any composition depth. From a frozen symbolic stack substrate containing no finished derived-field operation, the lineage can assemble and independently validate a new generic expression-operation definition, register it in serialized lineage state, and thereby execution-confirm the previously unreachable requirement plus all four fresh qualification worlds, while the inherited, acquisition-ablated and built-but-unregistered controls close nothing.
falsifiers: The inherited operation language can emit an ast.BinOp mapping value at any composition depth.
The required method is reachable or execution-confirmed before extension registration.
The substrate contains a finished derived-field operation rather than smaller stack instructions.
The bounded acquisition does not exhaust all 2,800 instruction programs or adopts no independently accepted definition.
The adopted definition is selected by a target, field, class, key or qualification-world name rather than by public behavior and content-addressed minimality.
The independent validator imports or reads the qualification pool.
Registration does not change the serialized operation-language state.
Any of the four fresh qualification requirements remains unreachable after registration or becomes reachable without acquisition.
More budget over the unchanged inherited language closes the binary-expression gap.
A built and validated but unregistered definition changes constructive reach.
The serialized extension fails an exact state round-trip or inherited operation identity changes.
Any evidence differs from clean local replay, the result is overwritten or rerolled, or model, network, remote or dirty-tree evidence enters Track A.

expressive_gap.inherited_invariant: each emitted mapping value is derived from exactly one self field, optionally under a unary container wrapper or zero-argument renderer call
expressive_gap.proof_method: structural closure over every inherited operation: mapping items are appended independently and no operation combines them; rendering maps each item independently, so depth and budget cannot introduce a binary expression
expressive_gap.differs_from_m091: M091 extended an abstract integer slot language. M097 extends the operation registry used to construct real Python source methods and validates the emitted source in fresh subprocesses.

assembly_substrate.selection_rule: shortest independently accepted construction, then canonical content digest

state_boundary.serialized: the acquired expression-operation definition and inherited operation digest
state_boundary.fixed_generic_host: the interpreter that turns registered symbolic definitions into AST mapping operations
state_boundary.not_yet_claimed: survival across complete process death with development modules absent; reserved for M098

mechanism.digest_rule: sha256 of canonical JSON mapping each listed path to its raw sha256

qualification_apparatus.digest_rule: sha256 of canonical JSON mapping each listed path to its raw sha256

qualification_population.construction: all four authored structures; no draw, exclusion, salt or reroll

owner_authorization: The project owner instructed continued local validation through M096, M097 and the persistence successor on 2026-08-22. This authorizes local freeze and execution, not public push.
verdict_rule: positive only when all twelve frozen conditions are computed and true
